about: AP Precalculus concept dependency map (docs/apprecalc-spec.md, docs/apprecalc-phase0.md): the 58 CED topics in CED order (Unit 4 built as "beyond the exam", spec decision 7), the "Algebra you need" skills with the topic each comes before, and every concept with the topic that teaches it, the concepts it depends on and, for math notation, the TeX patterns that use it. Read by scripts/check-apprecalc-map.mjs and scripts/build-apprecalc.mjs.

ced.edition: Course and Exam Description effective fall 2026 (4 units, 58 topics; content unchanged, about 40 essential knowledge statements reworded)
ced.note: Built from docs/apprecalc-ced-map.json, itself from docs/apprecalc-research/framework.md. Units 2-4 objectives come partly from third-party summaries (docs/apprecalc-needs-author.md ced-text).
